title: Solids Texture Pack
description: A Minecraft Bedrock FPS-boosting PvP texture pack featuring 1×1 solid-color blocks, disabled particles/animations, dark UI, box crosshair, and clean 16×16 sword textures for maximum performance
full_description:
Solids Bedrock By HeyHazik — Full Description

 

---

 

**Solids Bedrock By HeyHazik is a highly optimized, performance-first Minecraft Bedrock Edition texture pack designed specifically for PvP players and low-end mobile devices who need every single frame per second they can get.**

 

**This pack completely replaces every block texture in the game with ultra-minimal 1×1 pixel solid color images, eliminating all texture detail that the GPU would normally have to render, resulting in dramatically smoother gameplay and significantly higher frame rates across all devices.**

 

**Every single one of the 339+ block textures — from dirt, grass, stone, ores, wood, leaves, concrete, wool, terracotta, glass, nether blocks, end blocks, deepslate variants, corals, and more — has been reduced to a single solid pixel of its representative color, meaning your device spends almost zero resources rendering the world around you.**

 

**All particle effects have been completely disabled and replaced with fully transparent 1×1 invisible textures, meaning explosions, critical hit sparks, smoke plumes, enchantment glows, potion effects, water splashes, lava drips, soul fire embers, sculk vibrations, and every other particle in the game simply does not render, saving massive amounts of processing power during intense combat.**

 

**Fire, lava, water, portals, prismarine, sea lanterns, magma, kelp, seagrass, and all other animated block textures have been converted to completely static single-frame solid color images, eliminating all texture animation loops that would normally consume CPU and GPU cycles every single tick.**

 

**Rain and snow weather visuals have been fully removed and replaced with transparent textures, so even during storm weather conditions your frame rate will not drop a single frame, keeping your PvP performance consistent no matter what the in-game weather is doing.**

 

**The entire user interface has been redesigned with a sleek, minimal dark theme — all buttons are deep dark grey with subtle dark borders, all panels and backgrounds use near-black colors, and all UI animations have been stripped out so menus open and close instantly without any transition lag.**

 

**A custom PvP-optimized box crosshair has been included, featuring clean white corner bracket edges forming a precise targeting box in the center of your screen, giving you sharper and more accurate target tracking during fast-paced combat compared to the default crosshair.**

 

**All six sword types — wooden, stone, iron, golden, diamond, and netherite — have been given sharp, clean, hand-crafted 16×16 pixel designs with distinct blade, guard, and handle colors for each tier, making it instantly clear which weapon you are holding during a fight without any visual confusion.**

 

**The pack name displays in bold red text inside Minecraft's resource pack menu as "Solids Bedrock By Hazik", and the description also appears in red reading "This Pack Is For FPS Boosting and PvP By HeyHazik", making it easy to identify in your resource pack list.**
